meta.notes: W-T (the pitch deck's #4: one local weapon per region, 'a canoe paddle in the PNW'). A varnished cedar canoe paddle, swung in the sweep stroke as taught at summer camp: one swing lands on a rider on each side (melee.sweep, like the campaign sign, but heavier and slower to fold). Cracks after 8 swings that land. Lies only on Pacific Northwest roads. Crude starting numbers, [default].
